headline: 33 senior police officers sent to compulsory retirement by government
summary: The group includes 14 DIGs, 17 Additional DIGs, and 2 SPs, effective immediately.
details: The Bangladesh government has sent 33 senior police officers to compulsory retirement. This decision was announced in a notification issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs on Sunday, July 5.
Among those retired, there are 14 officers of Deputy Inspector General (DIG) rank, 17 Additional DIGs, and 2 Superintendents of Police (SP).

The DIGs include Molla Nazrul Islam, Saiful Islam, Miraj Uddin Ahmed, Shah Mizan Shafiur Rahman, S M Mostaq Ahmed Khan, Jihadul Kabir, Moinul Haque, Elias Sharif, Shyamal Kumar Nath, Zakir Hossain Khan, Shah Abid Hossain, Jamil Hasan, Mahbubur Rahman, and Md. Moniruzzaman.

The Additional DIGs include Barkatullah Khan, T M Mojahidul Islam, Anwar Hossain Khan, Moha. Moniruzzaman, Mehedul Karim, Alamgir Kabir, Rashidul Hasan, Sanjay Kumar Kundu, Nizamul Haque Molla, S M Imran Hossain, Saidur Rahman Khan, Shamsunnahar, Saifullah Al Mamun, Khan Muhammad Rezwan, Sajid Hossain, Sheikh Rafiqul Islam, and Mashrukur Rahman Khaled.
The retired SPs are Molla Jahangir Hossain and Abdullah Aref.
According to the notification, the retired officers will receive all retirement benefits as per service rules. The order is effective immediately in the public interest.
